title: Unit Event — Deep Dark for Light

meta.Outline: On the last day of the workshop, Wonderlands×Showtime learn about the upcoming ArcLand Show Contest, and they decide to compete. Faced with the challenging role of a prince beset by despair, Tsukasa becomes keenly aware of the gap between himself and Asahi.

rows.Line: ArcLand - Workshop Venue

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: And that officially wraps up this workshop. Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: Particularly thanks to the help of our guest lecturers, this has proven to be a deeply rewarding experience for us all.

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: I hope what you've learned here will prove useful to you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Today was the final day of ArcLand's workshop.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Not only was it an opportunity to learn from world-class instructors, but it was a valuable chance to interact with ArcLand's cast as well.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It is a shame that such fulfilling days are coming to an end...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But we mustn't stop moving forward! We will take what we've learned here and make it fuel for our continued growth!)

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: Oh, however... One more thing, before we part ways.

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: I have a very important announcement for you all.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: An important announcement?

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: In the near future, we will be hosting the ArcLand Show Contest.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The ArcLand...Show Contest?

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: ArcLand is currently working on an initiative to create new shows.

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: Ordinarily, new productions would be focused on ArcLand's cast and crew...

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: But as I'm sure you're all aware, we here at ArcLand—especially the members of the Center Theatre—have made it our goal to create “shows that bring the world together”.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Shows that bring the world together...)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I'd already had some interest in ArcLand since it was famous for being a theme park that put on world-class shows.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: So, I came up with the idea of putting on shows at the Center Theatre that bring the world together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Shows that bring the world together...?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Haha. I guess that needs more explaining...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: In other words, ArcLand is currently working to do shows like the one Tom showed me.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: For all those people out there who are somehow surviving but are unable to smile...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: The cast of the Center Theatre plans to do shows around the world just for them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This is what Asahi was talking about.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I do recall him saying they were laying the groundwork for that goal...)

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: Of course, to achieve this goal, we'll need many brilliant actors.

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: And the best way to find brilliant actors is to create a space for talented young people to learn and gain experience.

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: That's why we decided to open participation to unaffiliated troupes, and present this opportunity in the form of a contest.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I see. This fits with ArcLand's usual style of doing things.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (They aren't simply focused on a box office take. This contest stands to improve the industry as a whole... It's an investment in the future.)

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: The troupe that wins this contest will be given a two-week run at the Center Theatre here in ArcLand.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...!
A run at the Center Theatre?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Despite operating as part of a theme park, the Center Theatre is one of the most prestigious theatres in Japan.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I felt lucky enough to stand on its stage during the workshop... I can only imagine the experience would be on another level with an audience.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (If we could perform on that stage, it would be an opportunity for growth unlike any we've experienced...!)

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: The judges for the contest will be ArcLand's production committee...

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: And Mr. Koryu Sakaki here will also participate as a special judge.

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: That's right, you're not rid of me just yet.

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: Oh, right, one more thing from me.

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: Maybe you've all guessed by now, but there might be something special lined up for anyone who produces particularly good results in the contest.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Something special?
Do you think he means like a parade?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I really don't think that's where this is going, no...

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: I'd like to get my hands on some of this sparkling new talent too, after all.

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: I'm not making any promises, but who knows? I might drop you a little invitation. Maybe to one of my productions overseas.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Overseas...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Which means...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This could be a first step toward the world stage...!)

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: So break a leg, won't you?

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: The full details of the contest will be posted to the ArcLand website tomorrow at noon, so please be sure to check them out.

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: Once again, thank you all for your participation. We look forward to your future endeavors.
Scramble Crossing
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Everyone!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I know this is sudden, right after the workshop, but I have a matter to discuss with you! It concerns—

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The contest, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm! W-Well, yes—

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Of course we're entering, right, Tsukasa?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?! O-Of course we are! This is a chance to step onto the world stage, and—

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And it would be a shame to let it pass us by. Is that about right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let... Let...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Let me finish a sentence!!!
You're hardly leaving any lines for me!!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, apologies.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm just as happy as you are to have received this opportunity, after all, and I couldn't help myself.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Same. It sounds like a great chance to see just what we can do now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And if everything goes well, it could even bring us closer to our dreams. There's no way we could pass this up.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I really, really want to learn how things work behind the scenes for such a big theatre, too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's win the contest and take a flying leap toward our dreams!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Honestly... I'm certainly in no position to talk, but I don't know if this is bravery or recklessness...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But that's the spirit! I can see we're all motivated!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In that case, I have nothing further to say!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wonderlands×Showtime! We're going to enter that contest... And we're going to win!

rows.Speaker: Nene, Emu & Rui
rows.Line: Yeah!!
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: One, two, three, four!

rows.Speaker: Emu & Nene
rows.Line: Five, six, seven, eight!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Excellent! Let's move right from warm-up stretches into vocal exercises... Is what I would say, but...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui still isn't here. And he said he was bringing the script today.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This morning, he said he'd finished and was doing one last check, but... Ah!
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
It's Rui!
Good morning, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're pretty late. What have you been...huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
So, there...use Rembrandt lighting...
No need for a blackout at the end...
se_walk_men_001_3

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?! He walked right past us!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What's going on?! Rui! What's the matter?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah...
se_walk_men_001_3

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Haha, forgive me. I was thinking about my plans for the direction while I walked, and it seems I ended up being completely absorbed.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see... That certainly does sound like you, but... You should be careful not to get hurt, you know?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now then. How did the script turn out?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I believe I've poured everything I've learned so far into it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Someone sounds confident.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I've made full use of everything I experienced and learned through the workshop, after all.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That's good, then!
Let's get to reading!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “The Princess and the Cursed Flower”...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ooh, so the main character is a princess!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: ArcLand has upheld the motto “anyone can be a princess” since its founding.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That same concept is also the theme for this contest...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So how each troupe interprets it will be the deciding factor.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, exactly.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The early parts of the play are comedic, but... I see. Things begin to change around the middle.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (That will call for a change in our acting approaches, I'm sure. And from there...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I see... So this is how the plot develops.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But what happens to the prince after that? Surely...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui!!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This script is...fascinating!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I was considering my acting choices up to around the middle, but by the end I was wholly engrossed. Well done!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah! I really liked the message that anyone can be a princess if they guide the one they love.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's start our read-through right away! Oh, but we have to do our vocal warm-ups first!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you all. Hearing you say that makes all the thought I put into it worth it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, let's begin as soon as we've warmed up!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It looks like everyone's ready. Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The main character of this show is the princess, Nene's role.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I play the deuteragonist, the prince. Ordinarily, one would expect a love story between the two...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But this show begins after that.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Princess! The Dark Lord lies defeated. I have come to rescue you!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Oh, my prince...! My beloved! Take me from this place, and I'll stay by your side, wherever you may go!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “And so the prince and princess were married. And they all lived happily ever after.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “However, this is where our story begins. What comes after 'happily ever after'?”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Here, take this bread. Make sure to share it with your family.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Phew... That's everything we have to give out today.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Princess Harte! Wonderful work as always, your Highness!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “A princess of our kingdom, distributing food to the poor and needy! You truly are an example to us all!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Thank you for saying so. But it's nothing to praise me for.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “I'm still a newcomer to this kingdom, after all. This is about all I can do for you.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “And with the treasury being used up in the border clashes with our neighbor, the number of misfortunate people will only increase...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“Still...
*Sigh*
Today is the tenth day...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “It's been ten whole days since I've seen his face!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “My, my, your Highness! If you want to see Prince Blesse so badly, you could pay him a visit yourself instead of working so diligently.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “I suppose that's true... But somehow, the idea annoys me.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “He used to say such beautiful things about loving me forever and whatnot, but he hasn't paid me a single visit lately.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “There's nothing for it, my lady. His Highness will inherit the throne from his father someday, and he must prepare for it.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“That's true, but...
*Sigh*
I think I'll go for a walk to clear my head.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Of course! Do take care!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Harte! Where are you, Harte?”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Oh? She just left for a walk not a moment ago.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “What?! And just when I was able to make some free time...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Your Highness. You still have quite a lot of work to do. Just where do you think you're going?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Ugh, Nidd...!
Very well, I'll be right there...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (And so, with the prince's duties taking up his time, the two continue to miss one another.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (All the while, an aide that supports Blesse's younger brother plots to steal the throne...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The aide places a curse on him with a flower that grows within the kingdom.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (And the prince, now cursed, begins to sink into despair. Then...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Right! That's all our work finished for the day!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Huh? But you have that meeting with the messenger from the neighboring kingdom to negotiate for peace...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “It's not as though that will actually improve relations, right?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “I'd rather spend some quality time with you, Harte!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Are you sure? Somehow, this doesn't seem like you...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “But it has been such a long time since we've gone anywhere, just the two of us...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “You mentioned wanting to go boating on the lake, didn't you? Today is the perfect weather for a little cruise!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“Oh, really?
Okay... I'll go change into my new dress!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (At first, the princess is overjoyed that the prince is making more time for her.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But at the lake, they meet a fairy, who tells them that the prince has been cursed.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (So the princess and prince go on a journey to break the curse. But...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Prince! Hurry up and walk already!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “You have to uproot the cursed flower yourself, or the curse will never be broken!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “I know that, fairy! But it's as though my body refuses to heed me...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Something dark whispers in my mind. It says that pulling up the flower is pointless. That it won't change anything...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Blesse...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The cursed flower's influence grows as they get closer to it.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The closer the prince gets to breaking the curse, the stronger the feelings of emptiness that assault him...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And by the time they're a stone's throw from their destination, the mountain's summit, he's fully immobilized by despair.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “No more...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Thank you, Harte... But this is the end. There's nothing left for me.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“Blesse! Come on, Blesse!
This isn't like you!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “None of this matters.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“No matter what I do, humanity will still hate.
Countries will still wage war.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “No matter how much we wrack our brains, no matter what we try to accomplish... Nothing ever changes.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “It's all meaningless.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Blesse!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “I won't let you do this!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “I want to stay with you, Blesse! I want to see what our future together will be like!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “So... I won't ever let you give up on me!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “If you feel like everything is meaningless, then we'll find a meaning together!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “So get back on your feet!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The princess all but carries the prince up the mountain, and somehow they finally reach the flower.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (And finally, the cursed flower is uprooted...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mm. Excellent.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's only our first read-through, but you've already grasped your roles rather well. Honestly, I'm impressed.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Woohoo!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank goodness... Hehe, I like this role. I feel like I naturally fit into it, somehow.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! Harte's stubbornness is very similar to you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And just what is that supposed to mean?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah! Exactly as it sounds!
I'm looking forward to a great performance!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (In truth, this role is the perfect fit for Nene in many ways. Harte has a grouchy side, but she's passionate and driven, and strong enough to bear hardship.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The role that will require careful attention this time...is mine.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (A passionate man driven by great love... I'm familiar with roles like that. However...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (As Blesse is affected by the curse, he gradually sinks into despair.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (That portrayal must ring true, or no matter how hard Nene works, the show as a whole will feel empty.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (A prince gradually losing himself to despair... I must grasp this role completely.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Someone's phone is ringing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, that would be mine.
Hm?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What is it?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's a call from an unexpected person.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Asahi.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Emu & Nene
rows.Line: Huh?!
A few days later
ArcLand - Practice Room

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I know this was on short notice, so thanks again for agreeing to it.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Everyone... We'll be practicing jointly from today on. Let's make the most of it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I was surprised to hear you'd be entering the contest too, Asahi.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Haha! True, you wouldn't expect an ArcLand team to participate in an external-facing contest, huh?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: But the higher-ups apparently want this to be an opportunity for ArcLand's younger actors too.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: We've been told to show what we can do on a level playing field with other troupes. No relying on our more experienced coworkers at all.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. That does sound like it'll be a good experience.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Yeah! And we're all excited to go head-to-head with actors and directors around our own age, with only our own skills!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I can imagine... It's exciting for me too, and it's bringing out my competitive spirit.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's all compete to make the best shows we can!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I hope we can all bring one another to greater heights. That's why I invited you to practice with us, after all.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: So let's all do our best! We won't let you beat us, though!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course! We have no intention of losing, either!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: Oh! Wonderlands×Showtime, you came! Good to see you all again!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: I'm so glad we get to practice next to you! We'll be splitting up our programs, but we can stretch and do vocal warm-ups together!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah...of course! Thank you for having us once again!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Okay, everyone! Let's get stretching!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Nene & Rui
rows.Line:
Right!
Okaaay!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The invitation was a surprise... But we're lucky to have this opportunity.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (We'll be getting to watch our competitors from ArcLand up close... This ought to make for fine motivation.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'll have to put in more effort than ever...!
One hour later

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm just sick of rice balls, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, that seems like a good note to end the improv exercises on. Let's split up and start rehearsing, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Understood. Let's say everything from this desk over will be us, and the other half will be you guys.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Agreed! Until later, then!
se_walk_men_002_4

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's get right into it. Is everyone ready to start from the opening lines?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's go, full power!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We have less than two months until the contest. We can't waste a single second.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This may be a joint practice, but what I have to do hasn't changed.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Take everything I've learned in our training, and embody my role fully!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Take my hand, Harte! Let's retire to our paradise of love, just the two of us!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “H-Hey! Blesse?!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, this is shaping up well. I especially like how much of the stage you're utilizing, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This show is meant to be enjoyable for all ages, so I'd always intended the acting to be somewhat overstated. You're doing exactly what I want you to.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... In that case, am I maybe being too subdued?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mm... You're not doing badly, but...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It might be something to keep in mind. Harte is somewhat withdrawn, so if your performance is too naturalistic, that big stage may swallow you up.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
You're right...
How about something like this?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm, that still seems a little small.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It might be best to consider me as a reference.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The audience will see both Harte and Blesse on stage. We'll be compared no matter what. So for balance, you'll need to match me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The same applies for the speed of your movement. So move like me, but a little slower... Like this, maybe.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see... Thanks, Tsukasa! I'll give it a try!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Of course!
Oh, right, Rui. About this line here...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Harte criticizes Blesse and he snaps back at her, right? I've been playing it as a comedic moment and reacting instantly, but... This is an important scene for showing their differing mindsets.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rather than playing up Blesse's shock, I wonder if pausing for a moment might make it more impactful. What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... I intended this scene to be a lively back-and-forth, but... Could you play it out for me?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, of course. Nene, let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay!
...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “You scoundrel! You absolute, utter cad! You don't care for me at all anymore, do you?!”

rows.Speaker: Nene

rows.Line: “They want you to stay with us! They don't want you to give up!”

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Yeah! Don't give up!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Stand up, Prince!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: You can do it, Blesse! Don't let it beat you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (What's going on...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It's so bright... What's this light...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (And...beyond the light...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The audience...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Right...
Right. The world is still...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (They still need my shows.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (My dream isn't...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It hasn't ended yet...Harte.)

rows.Speaker: Harte
rows.Line: “Blesse!”

rows.Speaker: Blesse
rows.Line: “Harte...”

rows.Speaker: Blesse
rows.Line: “Haha... I feel like I've woken from a terrible nightmare.”

rows.Speaker: Blesse
rows.Line: “Forgive me. I was weak... I almost let the curse win.”

rows.Speaker: Blesse
rows.Line: “But... With you with me, I feel like I can take on anything. So...”

rows.Speaker: Blesse
rows.Line: “Will you...stay with me, from now on?”

rows.Speaker: Fairy
rows.Line: “The rosebud opened! What a lovely scent...”

rows.Speaker: Harte
rows.Line: “You fool! You utter fool!”

rows.Speaker: Harte
rows.Line: “If only you had shared your worries and pain with me from the start!”

rows.Speaker: Blesse
rows.Line: “Harte...”

rows.Speaker: Harte
rows.Line: “Let's think on it together. We can find a way for everyone to live in happiness.”

rows.Speaker: Harte
rows.Line: “And build a truly happy ending, with our own hands.”

rows.Speaker: Harte
rows.Line: “Our story will end with, 'And so the prince and princess overcame their troubles, and everyone lived happily ever after!'”
One hour later

rows.Speaker: Contest Host
rows.Line: And so, last but not least, we have the grand prize winners.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Our name hasn't come up yet.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (So, we either won...or we're out of the running.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (We did everything we could.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Whatever happens, we'll accept it.)

rows.Speaker: Contest Host
rows.Line: The winners are...

rows.Speaker: Contest Host
rows.Line: The ArcLand team!

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: Ah... Yes, yes. Congratulations to the members of the ArcLand team.

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: It feels pretty self-congratulatory for an ArcLand team to win an ArcLand contest... But in the end, your performance was the most polished.

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: Especially you, Asahi Genbu. I got to see something pretty special today. Thanks for that.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Not at all! Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The heart is not so easily marshaled...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (As expected... This hurts.)

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: Oh, but...

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: This time around, we had a separate metric for success.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line:
Namely, “a show we'd like to see with a full house”.
And there was another show that fit that bill.

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: And so...

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: Wonderlands×Showtime. I think we'll have you play, as well.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: Call it a Jury's Special Award, I suppose.

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: Originally, the single winning group would perform for two weeks, but I'm sure the higher-ups will figure out a good way to split that time up.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Um, so that means...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll also be granted the opportunity to perform here...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Am I interpreting that correctly?

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: Yes, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: The original point of this contest was to bring in outside talent, after all.

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: Oh, right. You there. What was your name, again?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? Ah... T-Tsukasa Tenma, sir!

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: Tenma, eh. Got it.

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: That's all from me. You can take the mic back.

rows.Speaker: Contest Host
rows.Line: And so, with Mr. Sakaki's comments in mind, allow me to announce the final results.

rows.Speaker: Contest Host
rows.Line: Receiving the Jury's Special Award: Wonderlands×Showtime.

rows.Speaker: Contest Host
rows.Line: Though a tiny troupe with only four members, your passion for your craft created an immersive world upon the stage.

rows.Speaker: Contest Host
rows.Line: While somewhat irregular, Wonderlands×Showtime and the ArcLand team will both be given a run at the Center Theatre. We'll be in touch soon with the specifics.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, so... Isn't this...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: An absolutely positively wonderhoy result?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Through our own efforts, we've stepped up onto a new stage. Isn't that right, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This result was only to be expected!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: After all, we gave it our all, and we put on the greatest show we could!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So you say, but your eyes are a bit red.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: After all that hard work, I think a few happy tears are more than earned.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ah, Tsukasa! Do you need my hanky?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Argh! Don't fuss!
Let a man get misty!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ahem!
Listen to me, all of you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's continue giving this show everything we have... In front of the actual audience, too!

rows.Speaker: Rui, Emu & Nene
rows.Line:
Yes!
Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, everyone! Bye bye, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll be throwing ourselves into intensive rehearsals starting tomorrow. Be sure to rest up while you can.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Especially you, Tsukasa. You've been practicing a ton lately, so make sure you actually rest, okay?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, of course!
But for now, farewell!
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I wonder what it is...
The sunset looks so vibrant this evening.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It feels like today passed in a flash.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Though the afterglow still lingers...)
Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm?!
That voice...
se_run_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Asahi!
Is something the matter? You're still in costume...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Oh, yeah... I wanted to talk to you, but our debriefing ran long. I didn't want to miss you, so I had to come running.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You did that for me?! Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: No, I should thank you!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Your show today was amazing. Nene's singing and Emu's acrobatics have both gotten so much better, and Rui's direction was so impressive...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I almost forgot I was watching a play at all. It drew me in so well, I was on the edge of my seat.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: And...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I'm glad I got to see your performance today, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Ever since I first saw that night show at Phoenix Wonderland, I've considered you a talented and charming actor. But...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Seeing you perform today, I thought...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I don't want to lose to you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You...think that about me...?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I find your acting incredibly thrilling, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I'm always thinking, “What expression will he make next? What will he show us next?”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: It's so much fun. But...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: At the same time, it leaves my chest burning.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Asahi...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm honored.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What you said... That burning in your chest. I believe it's the same sensation I've been feeling since the moment I met you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You've always been blindingly bright in my eyes. So...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm overjoyed to finally stand on the same stage as you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And with my friends by my side, I will continue to fight to catch up to you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As your rival.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Let's both give it our all in our next shows.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (My chest feels so hot.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Asahi...sees me as a rival.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (In that case, I'll have to redouble my efforts.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (As his rival, as an actor, to bring both of us to greater heights!)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: (He still has so much potential to improve. I can feel it.)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: (Why is that, I wonder? Is it because he's still growing? Or could it be...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And with my friends by my side, I will continue to fight to catch up to you.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Friends...
